MIND. [1] [Kalm.]
In a recumbent posture, mental faculties and memory perfect, but on attempting to move, vertigo.
Anxiety with palpitation.
Toward evening and next forenoon very cross.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Kalm.]
Vertigo : with headache, blindness, pains in limbs and weariness ; while stooping and looking down.
Vertigo : with aching in face. θ Neuralgia.
Giddiness, with headache and nausea.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Kalm.]
Pulsating headache in forehead.
Pain in forehead in morning when waking, < after rising.
Aching in forehead, followed by rending in bones of right or l. side of face ; shooting downward into eye teeth ; moving backward down neck and outwardly on both sides ; succeeded by pain in left shoulder ; rending in bones of legs to feet.
Pain over right eye ; giddiness ; eyes weak and watery.
Pressing pain on a small spot on right side of head.
Headache internally, with sensation, when turning, of something loose in head, diagonally across top.
A cracking in head frightens him, it ends in a sound in ears like blowing a horn.
A shuddering without coldness commence with cracking as if surcharged with electricity.
Severe pressing headache, < and > with sun.
Sensation of heat in head in morning.
Dulness in head ; headache ; backache.
Neuralgic paroxysmal pains.
Headache < in evening and in open air.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Kalm.]
Pain from back of neck up over scalp to top of head and temples, also affecting face right side ; tender to touch ; pain shooting twitching ; sometimes in spots ; > from cold, < from heat ; every afternoon, last with great severity, through night. θ Neuralgia.
Rheumatic pain in scalp.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Kalm.]
Glimmering before eyes.
Everything black before eye when he looks downward ; nausea and eructations of wind (in morning).
Dull, weak eyes.
Retinitis albuminurica, occurring during pregnancy ; pains in back.
Nephritic retinitis accompanied by much pain in back, as if it would break.
Sclera inflamed, vitreous perfectly filled with exudation, and glimmering before eye, especially on reading with the other. θ Sclero-choroiditis anterior.
Sclerotis, particularly in rheumatic subjects ; eyeball painful on motion.
Parenchymatous keratitis.
Severe pain in right eye, extending to forehead ; commences at sunrise, < until noon ; then > and leaves at sunset. θ Neuralgia oculorum. (After Acon. and Bellad. failed.)
Pressure in right eye (evening) ; also above right eye.
Stitches in eyes, ears, fingers and feet.
Itching in eyes ; when rubbing them they sting.
Pain in eyes, which makes it painful to turn them.
Sensation of stiffness in muscles around eyes, and of eyelids.
Asthenopia ; stiff, drawing sensation in muscles upon moving eyes.
Eye symptoms < evening and in open air.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Kalm.]
Stitches in and behind right ear ; in neck and thighs, at night.
Sound like blowing a horn, after cracking in head.
Meniere's disease.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Kalm.]
Coryza : with increased sense of smell ; with sneezing, dulness, headache and hoarseness.
Tearing in root of nose and nasal bones, with nausea.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Kalm.]
Face : red, with throbbing headache ; pale.
Anxious expression of countenance. θ Rheumatism of heart.
Flushing of face, with vertigo. θ Neuralgia.
Pressing pains in right side of face, especially between eye and nose.
Prosopalgia, right sided ; pains rending ; agonizing ; stupefying or threatening delirium.
Fothergill's faceache.
Severe neuralgia in right cheek, with alkaline taste in mouth.
Facial neuralgia, involving teeth of upper jaw, but not from caries.
After exposure to cold, pains in right side of head, ear and face, and even going down to arm, sometimes attended with numbness, or succeeded by numbness in parts affected ; pains sticking, teasing, pressing, or shooting in a downward direction ; pains occur at irregular times, continue for no definite period, coming suddenly or gradually, and leaving as uncertainly ; < by worry or mental exertion ; > by food. θ Neuralgia.
Facial neuralgia after zoster.
Face itches at night.
Roughness of cheeks (during every Summer).
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Kalm.]
Lips swollen, dry and stiff.
Cracked lips with dry skin.
Stinging in jawbones.
Tired feeling in chewing muscles.
Stitches and tearing in lower jaw.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Kalm.]
Teeth tender, with neuralgia of face.
Pressing pain in molars, late in evening.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Kalm.]
Bitter taste with nausea, > after eating.
Tongue : white, dry ; sore left side ; hurts hen talking.
Stitches in tongue.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Kalm.]
Tingling in salivary glands, immediately after eating, with sense of fermentation in œsophagus and copious salivation.
Sublingual salivary gland inflamed.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Kalm.]
Throat feels swollen ; sensation as if a ball was rising.
Sensation of dryness in throat, difficult deglutition, thirst.
Pressure in throat ; stitches in eyes and nausea.
Great dryness of throat, with aching pains, the dryness causing frequent cough. θ Chronic syphilitic sore throat.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Kalm.]
Pains > by food. θ Neuralgia.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Kalm.]
Eructations of wind. θ Angina pectoris. θ Gastralgia.
Nausea, everything becomes black before eyes, pressure in throat, incarcerated flatus, oppression of breathing, rheumatic pains in limbs.
Wine relieves vomiting.
